component.name: jsNetMonitor
component.summary: See what your network does — every device, every connection, every program

description.p: jsNetMonitor shows the traffic of every network connection of your computer live — cable, Wi-Fi, mobile, bundled connections, bridges, VLANs and VPN tunnels — in the look of a studio rack.

ul.li: Download and upload of each device, as smooth curves and level meters
Which program uses the network, and how much
Every connection with remote host, country, service, state, speed and latency
Where your traffic goes: destinations and countries at a glance
Your total traffic over minutes, hours, a week, a month or a whole year
Traffic per day and month, kept across restarts
The network chip, its driver, firmware and link details
A small minimal view that stays on top
Arrange the device units as you like — the layout is remembered
Lists you can sort, widen and trim to the columns you need

screenshot.caption: Every device with its traffic, and the total of the computer
Every connection with program, remote host and country
Where your traffic goes, by host and by country
The same in the light design
The small window that stays on top

description.p: On a light desktop the window now starts light when the design is set to automatic.
The window is now also found by older desktop tools that look for it by name.
